title: Chapter 264: A War That Far Exceeded Everyone'S Expectations
content:
Chapter 264: A War That Far Exceeded Everyone'S Expectations

Wu Qing deliberately cut off the reinforcements of the Zerg army, giving the aliens an illusion that they could still turn the tables.

The aliens may hate the Zerg to the extreme, or it may be that the will of the Lord of Light, the god they believe in, cannot be disobeyed, and their reinforcements have never stopped.

Now Wu Qing has given them hope, and this battle must continue.

The aliens have used all other means except sending the strong men behind them to directly participate in the battle, which will attract the siege of the local camp.

The Zerg puppies and the alien army fought fiercely in close combat, quickly consuming the troops of both sides. The battlefield was full of white light, which was the dead soldiers of both sides disappearing in light!

The number of troops on both sides quickly decreased from the peak state, and soon dropped to less than 10 million.

Just in this period of time, tens of millions of lives disappeared!

The alien army has more and more troops in the direction of the space transmission channel. The main combat arms of the Zerg army can no longer advance and can only form a defensive position on the spot and return to the defensive state.

The battle lasted until dark.

There were no more alien troops coming to support the 66th city. All the alien troops had gathered within the protection range of the city's lords and continued to attack the Zerg army.

The Zerg puppies were almost exhausted, and the goblins of the alien army were nowhere to be seen. Now the alien army on the battlefield is all the star-level arms of the alien army and various affiliated races.

The five-star arms headed by the alien light griffin knights were attacked by the five-star arms and Zerg queens in the Zerg army one after another during such a long battle. They were either killed or shot down and captured.

When the scale of the war reaches a certain level, the role of a small number of five-star troops is not so obvious. After suffering huge losses, the alien race did not send out five-star troops to participate in the war.

Now the main force of the alien army is the various one-star strength troops, among which the one-star troops of the alien army are stronger and comparable to two-star.

Cooperating with the stronger cavalry units and various long-range troops and simple siege weapons, the situation of the war is gradually reversed, and the Zerg army is effectively suppressed again.

The Zerg destroyers in the Zerg army can no longer fire at full power. They are not perpetual motion machines. Even if there is enough energy supply, they need to rest and recover.

The Zerg destroyers take turns to attack, rest and recover while fighting, and their attack firepower is weakened by more than half.

The main combat troops in the Zerg army, such as Zerg Hydralisks, Zerg Cockroaches, Zerg Stealth Spiders and Zerg Dragons, which attack for a long time, also need to rest and recover.

Up to now, the overall firepower output of the Zerg army has been reduced by at least half.

Not to mention the Zerg puppies who were almost killed or wounded.

This is the effect that the aliens have been fighting to achieve!

They have destroyed the Zerg army of tens of millions, and have made the high-star main combat arms of the Zerg army lose most of their combat power, and there are also many casualties.

This is the result of the alien army's one-day battle!

The losses of the aliens themselves are acceptable in the face of the great event of eliminating heretics.

The alien army is still being teleported through the space teleportation array.

It seems that if they work harder, the Zerg army will not be able to support it.

Wu Qing has never encountered such a large number of troops invested by the aliens. Even in the wars between many large tribes, they rarely invest so many troops.

Like the war between the Naga and the Skeletons, both sides invested more than 10 million troops. The failure of this battle made the Skeletons unbearable.

It can be seen that the loss of tens of millions of elite star-level soldiers is also a great loss for an ordinary large clan.

The scale of this war between the Zerg army and the alien army has exceeded that of the wars between ordinary large clans.

"I didn't expect that this war would eventually develop to such a scale!"

"Excluding the goblins, the star-level soldiers invested by the aliens have exceeded tens of millions!"

"Among them, there are also a large number of elite troops of the aliens!"

"The Zerg has also invested tens of millions of star-level combat forces. Their strength and foundation are not weaker than those of ordinary large clans!"

"Now the Zerg army is in decline again. I don't know if it is really exhausted or it is attracting the aliens to continue to invest!"

"No one knows the true strength of the Zerg, and even we can't judge the true intentions of the Zerg. "

"At this point, if the aliens don't hold on, the loss will be a bit big, at least it will have a major impact on the situation of the entire public battlefield!"

"Now for our local camp, whether the Zerg wins or loses, we have won!"

"Of course, if the Zerg can win, the situation of our public battlefield will be completely changed!"

"With such a long preparation time, if the Zerg still has spare energy, it is almost time to join the battlefield!"

"..."

The battle between the Zerg and the aliens has been fought like this, and the news has long been passed back to the main city and to all forces.

More observers from all forces rushed over. They not only want to observe the progress of this battle, but also want to deepen their understanding of the Zerg.

The scale of this battle exceeded everyone's expectations, and the impact of its results cannot be ignored.

The performance of the Zerg also greatly exceeded everyone's expectations. As soon as they came on the field, they had the strength to fight against the alien race alone. This strength cannot be ignored.

Now it is no longer everyone who is evaluating the performance of the Zerg, but the Zerg is changing the situation of the public battlefield in the entire southern theater.

From the news sent back, it is learned that the Zerg has acquired the ability to independently transmit a large number of troops and has gotten rid of its dependence on the main city. In the future, many intelligence of the Zerg will be difficult for observers of various tribes to accurately obtain.

The observation of the Zerg can only depend on the final result.

…

On the battlefield in the night, the offensive of the alien army became more and more fierce. If the Zerg pretends to be a pig to eat the tiger, it will really become a pig to be eaten by the tiger.

Wu Qing finally released the accumulated mass of Zerg puppies from the underground!

More and larger underground passages were opened than during the day, and countless Zerg puppies rushed into the battlefield like a black torrent of floodgates!

Even if the alien army was prepared for this scene, it was completely useless. The number of Zerg puppies was too large, and it felt more than during the day!

The main combat force of the Zerg army, except for the Zerg destroyers, all other arms stopped attacking and entered a state of rest and recovery.

In a very short time, tens of millions of Zerg puppies poured into the battlefield, like a huge black wave, sweeping everything!

No matter how powerful the enemy is, waves of Zerg puppies rush up, not caring about their own casualties!

This is completely opposite to the Zerg army's original attack method of not letting the enemy get close, it seems that this is the true character of the Zerg army!

The number of subsequent Zerg puppies pouring into the battlefield has not decreased at all, even though the Zerg puppies on the front line are constantly consuming a lot, their number is also increasing rapidly, and they are moving quickly towards 20 million!

Looking down from the sky, the battlefield in the night is illuminated by the light attribute energy of the alien human army, as bright as day.

On the entire battlefield, most of the area has become a black ocean composed of Zerg puppies. The black waves keep rushing towards the white alien army, just like the waves hitting the white beach, and like the rising sea water, gradually infecting the white beach.

The alien army is all star-level soldiers, and each type of soldiers is reasonably configured, well-trained, and powerful.

To be honest, I have been using Yeguo Reading to read books and follow the updates recently. It switches sources and has many reading voices. It can be used on Android and Apple.

Zerg puppies are ordinary soldiers that can be hatched with 50 energy. After the Zerg mother nest is upgraded, they have obtained multiple combat power upgrades, and their combat power is comparable to that of one-star soldiers.

The Zerg puppies are constantly charging against the various attacks of the alien army, launching a fierce attack on the formation of the alien army.

The killing efficiency of the long-range soldiers of the alien army is very high, and a large number of Zerg puppies fell on the way to charge.

The offense and defense of the Zerg army and the alien army have reversed again.

In the Zerg army, in addition to the original 50,000 high-star Zerg destroyers, Wu Qing reinforced 50,000 one-star Zerg destroyers.

The 50,000 one-star Zerg destroyers are the weakest, and they are in the worst condition after fighting for so long.

Wu Qing selected them and upgraded their strength to two-star.

The 50,000 two-star Zerg destroyers broke out of the cocoon and recovered to their best condition. They cooperated with the 50,000 high-star Zerg destroyers that could still attack at a low frequency and launched a devastating blow to the long-range troops in the alien army.

Under the unified command of the Queen, the Zerg puppies could not rush in any direction, and the Zerg destroyers would cover the area with their firepower.

Those newly hatched Zerg explosive mosquitoes also flew over the Zerg army to assist the Zerg puppies in breaking through the defense formation of the aliens.

The sound of "boom...!" continued to sound in various places in the alien army.

As long as the Zerg puppies break through the defense line of the alien army and fight with the alien army, the endless Zerg puppies will be like waves, impacting one after another and breaking all obstacles.

The number of Zerg puppies on the battlefield is still increasing, overwhelming and rushing in one direction.

Zerg destroyers and Zerg explosive mosquitoes suppressed most of the long-range attack arms in the alien army. A thousand Zerg queens who recovered their status followed the Zerg flying dragon group to fly to the alien army.

There are thousands of Zerg queens, among which 500 have five-star strength. They no longer use the ability of laying eggs, which consumes a lot of energy, but use the parasitic control ability to start mass-controlling various arms with strong lethality in the alien army.

The soldiers of the alien army who were parasitized and controlled by the Zerg queens turned around and slaughtered their former accomplices next to them!
